name: Paddy Ryan
role: Prizefighter, opponent of John L. Sullivan
bio: Paddy Ryan was a prizefighter whose rivalry with John L. Sullivan the Cow Boy followed, noting in 1885 that Medora's young men were practicing to challenge either and that the two had signed to fight at Butte City. In November 1886 the paper reported that Sullivan knocked Ryan out in the third round at San Francisco.
